_comment: `b.js` imports the CommonJS module `x.cjs`, then the lazy host `a.js`, then `y.js`. Native ESM runs `x`, `a`, `y`. In `esm` output, the file of `x.cjs` runs `x` at load, so the chunk of `b.js` initializes `a.js` right after its import of the host. In `cjs` output, `b.js` runs `x` in its body, at the read of the `default` export, so `x` cannot run before `a`. The chunk still initializes `a.js` right after its import, as the build without `import defer` does, so that `a` runs before `y`.
